## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by the unidentified *Dūnhuáng sān zàng* ("Tripiṭaka of Dūnhuáng") is the *Vinaya-viniścaya-upāli-paripṛcchā* — the Mahāyāna sūtra on Upāli's inquiry concerning *vinaya* (monastic discipline) decisions, presented from a bodhisattva-yāna rather than a *śrāvaka*-yāna perspective. The work is incorporated into the *[Mahā-ratnakūṭa](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0001)* as assembly 24 (*Yōubōlí huì* 優波離會).

**Abstract**

The translation is conventionally placed in the Western-Jìn period (266 – 316 CE), the bracket of the *Dūnhuáng sān zàng* honorific. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The text is the most important Mahāyāna *vinaya*-related text in the early Chinese tradition, presenting the *bodhisattva-yāna* perspective on monastic-discipline decisions.

The Taishō text (T0325) is established on the standard apparatus.
